purpose: Link students to courses and teachers.

courseId.description: ID of the course the student is enrolled in.

teacherId.description: UID of the teacher assigned to the student.

startDate.description: Start date of the enrollment in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: End date of the enrollment in YYYY-MM-DD format.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the enrollment was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the enrollment was last updated.

access_patterns.parent: read if studentId matches their childId
access_patterns.lp: read if assigned to the student

composite_indexes_needed.description: For querying enrollments by student and course.
For querying enrollments by teacher and status.

validation_rules: studentId, courseId, and teacherId must reference valid documents.
status must be one of the predefined statuses.
performance_notes: Indexes on studentId and courseId are critical for enrollment queries.
